1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 Bc5 4.O-O Nf6 5..strategy: Prepares the central advance, which the pawn on a5 does not hinder. The queenside pawn does give Black a way to harass the bishop if it retreats to b3, so White has to watch the bishop's retreat as the pawn centre grows.
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 Bc5 4.O-O Nf6 5..name: Italian Game: Classical Variation, Giuoco Pianissimo, with a5
